questions.title: Can a refund claw back more fee than we collected from the seller?
questions.question: When a refund comes in for a seller we have no fee on record from (no earlier settled sale), do we still claw back the full 10% plus $0.30 fee, or is the clawback limited to the fee we actually hold for that seller?

options.label: Always claw back the full fee on the refunded goods (a $100 refund returns $10.30)
options.clarification: A refund always claws back the full fee (10% of the refunded goods plus $0.30), regardless of how much fee has previously been collected from that seller.

options.label: Claw back only up to the fee still held for that seller (a $100 refund with no prior fee returns $0)
options.clarification: A refund claws back the fee on the refunded goods (10% plus $0.30), but never more than the fee still held from that seller's earlier settled sales after previous refunds; with no fee held, nothing is clawed back.
